text: Implemented FirstLevelTables shared binder, FirstLevelUnitDataset JVM opener, shared/JVM tests and workflow README. Applied only reserved new paths and baseline-checked README in native checkout; unrelated work preserved. Four shared tests pass JVM+JS: run order/leading zeros/repeated trials, exact coverage/conflicts, nuisance scan count, unresolved missingness. JVM test reads two selected NIfTI/TSV runs, ignores unrelated malformed event file and fits condition/FIR runwise models successfully. Logs /private/tmp/plsneuro-unit-binding-tests.log and /private/tmp/plsneuro-unit-dataset-tests.log exit 0. Native changes uncommitted; adopted in plsneuro cumulative patch 36efb9f5a9445c7dd217806fdfa67910cc167d4c1ca99ff1ddd244b9a32ace8c with fresh preparation success. Keep issue open for downstream catalog-to-loader integration acceptance (plsneuro E0.6); native test builds selected unit directly. API currently explicitly refuses missing event cells/nonfinite selected confounds and supports local file URIs only. Next action: application consumer catalog selection -> FirstLevelUnitDataset.open -> buildPlan -> fit, with subject/run provenance carried into UI.
